# robots.txt for https://kubaik.github.io
# Generated automatically - Do not edit manually

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Explicitly allow Googlebot
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /

# Allow Google AdSense crawler
User-agent: Mediapartners-Google
Allow: /

# Block sensitive paths only
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /.git/

# FIX (found in review, 2026): this file previously disallowed /tag/
# entirely, which blocked Googlebot from crawling EVERY tag page —
# including the ones _generate_tag_pages() explicitly marks
# <meta name="robots" content="index, follow"> because they clear the
# thin-content threshold (>= 8 posts). A per-page meta robots directive
# is irrelevant if the crawler is never allowed to fetch the page in the
# first place, so the two mechanisms were contradicting each other and
# the "indexed" tag pages were in practice unreachable. Thin tag pages
# (< 8 posts) still self-declare noindex via their own meta tag and
# don't need a robots.txt block on top of that.

# Explicitly allow Google's ad crawler regardless of the rule above
User-agent: Mediapartners-Google
Allow: /

# Sitemap
Sitemap: https://kubaik.github.io/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://kubaik.github.io/rss.xml
